description: What tools/actions.py may bind an action to on nx. Read only by Python tooling at build time; the engine never sees this file. Derived from engine/src/platform/nx/Input.cpp, which accepts only controller styles with the full set of controls and maps them by label: A to cross, B to circle, X to triangle, Y to square, L/R to l1/r1, ZL/ZR to l2/r2, the stick clicks to l3/r3, minus/plus to select/start. ZL and ZR are digital, so PlatformCapability::AnalogTriggers is false and there are no trigger sources. The front touchscreen exists but is answered live from the operation mode; touch is informational here.
